svg.title: 1 to 4 steady loads at once: frontend p99 10.0 ms alone, 14.3 to 14.8 ms at 4
svg.desc: Four panels, a reading each. Across, how many steady loads ran at once on the host, each on a cell of its own, on server 1.31.0 (gate/plans/noise.yaml); up, the reading in ms, a dot an item; the dashed line is the max the item was judged by, as its verdict records it. Sources: docs/tables/gate-items.jsonl, docs/tables/gate-readings-2.jsonl, docs/tables/gate-readings.jsonl, docs/tables/gates.jsonl.
svg.text: 1 to 4 steady loads at once: frontend p99 10.0 ms alone, 14.3 to 14.8 ms at 4
A dot an item, 10 in 4 noise waves, against its max: 10 ADVANCE; the lab host, an m8i.8xlarge
